bibliographic.title: Hospital from Hell
bibliographic.author: Boyan Botev
bibliographic.description:
A horror game where you try and save your son as you traverse through a hospital from hell.

You dropped your son and must atone for your sins by traversing through a nightmarish hospital.

A text and audio experience with music and sound design, with a Kafkaesque bureaucratic horror atmosphere that disintegrates at times into surrealism.
